profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Technical lead/architect with 20+ years of professional experience in distributed systems and end-to-end design and execution of data-driven, user-focused software.  Experienced with teams of all sizes and capabilities, in environments ranging from startup to industry leader.

Proficient with distributed systems/API design and execution including performance, scalability, and reliability, Java, SQL, Spring, data modeling, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, cloud services, content management, business & marketing automation, Unix/Linux/Windows/OS X.

Familiar with C++, Perl, Python, and C as well as SEO, most Internet technologies/protocol.

positions.title: Software Engineer (E6)
positions.description:
Services tech lead on Maps Product Infrastructure team.  Designed and implemented solutions to migrate from commercially sourced maps to OpenStreetMap.  Achieved numerous reliability and performance improvements (reduced average latency by over 90%), and a phased rollout with no outages while beating initial schedule estimate by 6 months.  Other significant efforts included working with cartographers for style updates, handling political views within the map, sensitive area restrictions and designing SLA-bound rapid-release pipeline to correct errors.
Architected and built Facebook’s first vector maps service, scaling project from a solo effort to a cross-functional team of 10+.  Designed and implemented a rules engine for processing OSM data into standard geometries with a friendly Lua-based configuration.  Wrote a complete implementation of the Mapbox Vector Tile Specification in C++.  
Directed development of new interfaces, procedures and improved reliability for the geocoder and address typeahead services.  Reduced frequency of significant outages by over 85%, with only 1 in my final 6 months.
Mentored and onboarded more than a dozen other engineers via the Bootcamp program.  Also managed an intern to a return offer and interviewed/screened dozens of candidates.  Participated in numerous site-building and recruiting events.

positions.title: CTO & Co-Founder
positions.description:
Co-founded first daily fantasy soccer website and grew to over £1 million in revenue.  Product owner.  Responsible for all game/rules design as well as technical architecture and  operations.  Oversaw all software development, testing, customer support and creative design.  Member of leadership team steering decisions on funding and overall strategy.
Core functionality of the product was a daily fantasy game for cash.  Data feeds provided team rosters as well as live and historical statistics.  Players build teams daily from numerous leagues as well as international competitions and can watch statistical performance live.
Product was deployed in multiple production environments and operated standalone as well as heavily integrated with international gaming partners.  Multi-lingual, multi-currency development with cash play available in several countries including US and UK.  Implemented solutions for compliance across 3 gaming licenses, including numerous ISO security audits.
Technologies personally used: Java, XML, Spring MVC, JSP, jQuery, Bootstrap, Spring JDBC, MySQL, Amazon EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, S3, RDS, Cloudfront. Firebase, Maven, Git.   The project also employed Backbone, Handlebars, Ratchet, Node.js, Grunt, and WordPress/PHP.

positions.title: Independent Software Architect/Developer/Consultant
positions.description: Various software development projects.  Clients include Time Inc., Zmags, HubSpot, and Cramer Interactive. Portfolio available online at efsavage.com.

positions.title: Independent Developer
positions.description: Lead technical resource for new innovation team.

positions.title: Independent Developer
positions.description: Adding productivity and experience to a new and growing team that is breaking new ground in accessibility.  Projects have included both front-end (Javascript) and back-end (Java) development, as well as integration with some third party services.

positions.description: Offered senior-level advice and execution on Wayfair's store front team during a leadership transition and reorganization of their front-end specialists.  Also built the internal tooling for an image gallery product where editors could tag designer portfolios with products offered by Wayfair.

positions.title: Independent Developer
positions.description:
Various Java web application development projects.
Wrote JNA-based interfaced to USPS address validation library.

http://efsavage.com/portfolio/cramer/

Used: Apache Tomcat, MySQL, JSF, JNA.

positions.title: Independent Developer
positions.description: Rebuilt a highly dynamic directory website for key HubSpot partners and vendors.  Concepts included content management, metrics gathering, and billing.  Required integration with Salesforce.com as well as numerous other internal systems.

positions.title: Senior Applications Architect
positions.description: Continued work of StyleFeeder after acquisition by Time, Inc.

positions.title: VP/Technology
positions.description:
Worked closely with founder/CTO to establish and execute technical strategy to grow e-commerce site (stylefeeder.com) from near-zero traffic to over 1 million registered users, 2 million unique monthly visitors and 15 million product listings.  Key participant in pivoting strategic direction of company (and website) through several funding rounds to eventual profitability and successful sale of company to Time Inc.
Major areas of effort include scalability, performance, and SEO (search engine optimization).   Managed recruitment and day-to-day efforts of most technical and creative contractors.  Led recruitment and assessment of developers post-acquisition to double the size of the technical team.
Designed and implemented data enrichment system to allow editorial and off-shore staff to edit and manage products for stylefind.com.  Included optimized workflows, UI, integration with datafeed loading and automatic classification systems, metrics reporting and data auditing.
Developed various specialized projects including Facebook application, Firefox plugin, customizable SWF/GIF widgets, public REST API, and partner integration and APIs for InStyle, Elle, and Zimbio.
Technologies leveraged include Java/J2EE, SQL, XML, HTML/CSS/JavaScript/jQuery/AJAX, Flash/Flex/ ActionScript, Linux, Amazon S3 & EC2.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for leading technical design and implementation of large-scale web sites and marketing automation tools for Fortune 500 clients.  Major projects included the NBA, Charles Schwab, AT&T (Consumer/ Wireless/ Web Cents), VeriSign/Network Solutions, GMC, Pontiac, IHG and eBay.  Additional work on Best Buy, Gillette, Celebrity Cruises and Time Warner.
Extensive use of Java, J2EE Java Servlets/JSP, SQL, XML/XSLT, HTML/CSS, and JSTL.  Significant usage of: MySQL, Resin, BEA WebLogic, ATG Dynamo, Oracle, Tomcat, Eclipse, Visio, and Emacs.  Solutions were developed and deployed on Linux, MS Windows, and Solaris environments.  Additional technologies used include Perl, C, CGI and web services (SOAP, WSDL).  Co-developed a content management system framework/API for rapid development of several CMSs, each managing tens of thousands of content pieces.
Projects required broad interdisciplinary coordination.  Advised during creative review cycles, information design/architecture, UI/UX design, marketing performance data collection, measurement and analysis.  Advised project managers on resource allocation and scheduling, and assisted directors in building project estimates.
Mentored other engineers and created and taught formal training sessions for technical and non-technical audiences on topics including XML, SQL, CSS, QA, and email spam.  Member of corporate cross-disciplinary Email Council, helping to develop best practices for clients.  Authored several white papers on topics including coding/markup guidelines, web site security, and QA processes.

positions.title: Engineer/Analyst
positions.description: Responsible for programming support of IDX software installed at health care organizations. Work closely with IT staff at several delivery networks, including Johns Hopkins University and Duke University. Software written in M (MUMPS), also uses modified SQL. Main products included BAR, Sched, IDXtend and DBMS.

positions.title: Enrollment Coordinator
positions.description:
Responsible for the loading and maintenance of insurance eligibility for over 250,000 lives annually across over 150 client organizations. Required coordination of MS Access, MS SQL Server, Visual Basic and AS/400 systems.  Developed several automation tools to dramatically reduce time and effort required for most tasks.
Initiated and co-developed large enrollment transaction system, related to above responsibilities.  System was built with Visual Basic, MS Access and SQL Server to provide real-time reporting and lookup functionality.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Assisted structural and project engineers with scheduling, planning.  Implemented a Microsoft Access based client/server application to replace paper forms and reports.  This system was ultimately rewritten as a Java web application and used across several projects to track hundreds of millions of dollars worth of time and materials.
